_comment: Template for an in-house (client server) installation. Copy the sections you need into the installation's own appsettings.Production.json or environment variables. Never put keys in this file. See docs/in-house-deployment/README.md.

Privacy._comment: Strict data rules. AllowedOutboundHosts: the API refuses to call any other host (the client's firewall egress list should match). Add the self-hosted Supabase host, the approved AI endpoints and, if used, the client's Azure Document Intelligence and Azure OpenAI hosts, and the cloud storage provider hosts. localhost is always allowed.

RegulRetrieval._comment: Search embeddings stay on the server. The shared appsettings.json uses azure-openai for the hosted demo.

Integrations._comment: Optional cloud storage import. Use the client's own app registration and their own callback address.
